candidate: funding-window edge raid two-sided auction resolver

week_selection.method: candidate-specific deterministic Monday selection from previously unused BTC weeks

market_representation.event_clock: causal daily equal-notional clock selected from preceding completed UTC day

scenario.precedence: failed auction is evaluated before durable acceptance
scenario.failure: completed close returns inside with aggressive flow toward opposite edge
scenario.failure_target: opposite edge of completed funding window
scenario.failure_stop: full raid-to-resolution path extreme plus one 7-bp side-cost buffer
scenario.acceptance: two outside closes and positive cumulative aligned flow after the response window
scenario.acceptance_target: one completed funding-window width projected beyond raided edge
scenario.acceptance_stop: raided boundary plus one 7-bp inside buffer
scenario.entry: market bracket on first official venue trade strictly after completed resolution

execution.market_data: official Binance Vision USD-M aggregate trades converted one-for-one to TradeTick
